description.value: Panorama Mountain Resort is a four-season alpine destination in BC's Kootenay Rockies, built around an intimate ski-in/ski-out village with 1,300 metres of vertical and nearly 3,000 acres of terrain. In summer the resort pivots to mountain biking, hiking, and guided adventures, with bike lessons and equipment rentals and repairs available on site. The self-contained village encompasses restaurants, pubs, cafés, hot pools, and accommodations, making it a notable stop for cyclists venturing deep into the Kootenays.
